root_cause.cause_2_result_timestamp_utc_local_conve: docs/tasks/TASK_141_RESULT.json's completion_timestamp (2026-08-05T09:23:40Z) closely matches a real clock read taken during TASK_141 ('Get-Date -Format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ' -> '2026-08-05T09:23:13Z'), which returns LOCAL time with a literal 'Z' (UTC designator) incorrectly appended.
